## Outcome
The exact ordinary, unrestricted Schwarz-Pick distortion limit at the boundary point is a known criterion for holomorphic Schwarz reflection across an open unit-circle arc containing that point. Recommend **already_solved, 0/5**, with credit to Kraus, Roth and Ruscheweyh (2007). This is a source-status correction, with no campaign discovery or priority claim.

## Exact scope and sources
The original OWR Problem 1 (pp.528-529) uses an unrestricted limit. The preceding arc theorem implies the pointwise conclusion through a uniform positive lower bound in a disk neighborhood. Gumenyuk, Kourou, Moucha and Roth, arXiv:2410.13965v1, Section 8.2 p.31 equation (8.3), also explicitly states this single-point equivalence.

Radial or non-tangential convergence has different consequences and is not silently substituted. The local extension gives a positive finite nonzero boundary derivative; it does not force an automorphism or extension across the entire circle.

## Independent review and limitations
The frozen artifact passed separate adversarial source and mathematical review without mandatory corrections. All 69 submitted and 187 independent exact controls pass. The complete 2007 journal proof was not accessible and is not independently certified. The exact theorem was inspected in the primary OWR source, and the later primary paper corroborates its use.

The six unchanged review files are included. Actual author and reviewer model: gpt-6-astra, xhigh. Zero fresh substantive proof attempts.

The campaign's single queue writer will add the **already_solved, 0/5** row update. This commit changes only this problem's attempt folder. No merge or release is requested.
